findings.text: tests/test_crew_tell_codex.py:87 _codex_argv hand-writes the override format production composes, so test_the_codex_predicate_reads_the_overrides_the_dialect_composes (line 266) and the acceptance case validate the predicate against the test's own copy; if reckon/_backends.py:1443 changes its format those tests stay green while every live codex run is refused.

reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2519 the predicate hard-codes the hooks.PostToolUse, hooks.state and trusted_hash shapes owned by reckon/_backends.py:1443, so the live path and the composer can drift apart without a failing test.

reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2598 the codex branch no longer consults record["fenced"], so an unfenced codex run carrying both overrides is now admitted where the previous code refused every unfenced run; no test covers that case and the fragment does not record the widening.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that crew tell reach a live codex run whose recorded launch argv carries both overrides; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2598 branches on dialect and admits a codex run only when _codex_inbox_override_gap finds both overrides on record["argv"].
VERDICT done_when: the done-when names tests over the codex and Claude cases plus a clean ruff on the staged paths; after-suite.log records 64 passed with EXIT=0 at eee1a677 and baseline-suite.log 51 passed with EXIT=0 at e70e9be2, and I measured ruff clean on both staged paths under the repository's declared config.
VERDICT write_paths: read the reviewed manifest's four declared paths; the three paths the diff touches are all inside them, and the figures directory went unused because the done-when names no artifact.
VERDICT manifest: read; it reports 64 passed at the head arm against 51 passed at the base arm, the negative control at 5 failed with EXIT=1, status complete, and a landing line naming the per-dialect decision.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against e70e9be2, eee1a67746 (the source change plus a 273-line test file) and 6c82e335f4 (the evidence fragment only); no path outside the declared scope is touched.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2501 crew_tell (the CLI verb that runs the predicate, with no internal caller), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3407 (writes the record's "argv" the predicate reads), reckon/_backends.py:1443 _inbox_hook_flags (composes the two overrides the predicate matches)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2598 admits a codex run only when both overrides are on the recorded argv, refuses naming the missing one, and leaves the Claude branch's settings test unchanged.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: after-suite.log and baseline-suite.log record 64 against 51 passing with EXIT=0 and negative-control.log records 5 failed with EXIT=1, though the ruff clause of the done-when is asserted only in the fragment and has no recorded log.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the diff's three files, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, tests/test_crew_tell_codex.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-live-worker-can-be-reached/crew-tell-admits-codex.html, are all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
SCORE durability: 15
JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-control.log shows the five refusal cases redden when the codex branch accepts any run, but tests/test_crew_tell_codex.py:87 builds its own copy of the override format, so the acceptance side cannot detect a drift in reckon/_backends.py:1443.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helper sits at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2495 beside the verb with the function-local import idiom the surrounding commands already use, and no name carries a plan or ticket label.
SCORE reuse: 14
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/_backends.py:1443 owns the composition of the two overrides and this addition restates that format as prefix checks at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2519 instead of deriving from it; I searched reckon/ for an existing reader of recorded codex overrides and found only the composer sites.
FINDING tests/test_crew_tell_codex.py:87 non-blocking: _codex_argv hand-writes the override format production composes, so test_the_codex_predicate_reads_the_overrides_the_dialect_composes (line 266) and the acceptance case validate the predicate against the test's own copy; if reckon/_backends.py:1443 changes its format those tests stay green while every live codex run is refused.
FINDING reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2519 non-blocking: the predicate hard-codes the hooks.PostToolUse, hooks.state and trusted_hash shapes owned by reckon/_backends.py:1443, so the live path and the composer can drift apart without a failing test.
FINDING reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2598 non-blocking: the codex branch no longer consults record["fenced"], so an unfenced codex run carrying both overrides is now admitted where the previous code refused every unfenced run; no test covers that case and the fragment does not record the widening.
